preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some LuffyInu tokens to sell
Attacker must NOT be the owner and NOT be in excludeFee mapping

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is that when selling tokens to the pair (uniswapV2Pair), the liquidity fee is transferred to the pair address but not actually added to liquidity. This means the fee tokens remain in the pair contract as regular tokens rather than being converted to LP tokens. Attack by: 1. Ensure taxStatus is true, 2. Sell LuffyInu tokens to the uniswapV2Pair, 3. The liquidity fee (1%) will be sent to the pair but not properly added to liquidity, 4. The attacker can then buy back tokens at a lower price or manipulate the pool since the fee tokens remain in the pair contract as sellable assets rather than locked liquidity.
